NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY.description: NVIDIA NIM key (build.nvidia.com -> Get API Key)

AI_API_KEY.description: Optional: generic key for openai/anthropic/glm/custom providers

CUSTOM_BASE_URL.description: Optional: base URL of any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint (used with CUSTOM_API_KEY)

CUSTOM_API_KEY.description: Optional: key for the CUSTOM_BASE_URL endpoint

WEBSITE_CREDENTIALS.description: Credentials for the authorized target website (JSON)

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional: Telegram bot token from @BotFather (enables the control bot)

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Optional: chat id(s) allowed to command the bot, comma-separated. Send /start to the bot to learn your id.
